summary: Completed comprehensive testing of 3D prints e-commerce website. Backend APIs are fully functional (100% success rate). Frontend has significant improvements from previous iteration - admin dashboard now works correctly, but regular user authentication still has cookie handling issues that prevent full checkout flow testing.

integration_issues.issue: Session cookies not being properly recognized for regular users despite working for admin users with same cookie configuration
Cannot fully test checkout flow due to authentication issues preventing access to checkout page

design_issues.issue: Gradient backgrounds may not be properly implemented or detectable in automated testing

passed_tests: All backend API endpoints (18/18 tests passed)
Landing page loads with hero section and parallax effects
Product listing page displays 5-6 products correctly with images
Add to cart functionality works without authentication
Cart page shows items with quantity controls and remove functionality
Product detail page with image gallery and quantity selector
Category filtering on products page works
Admin dashboard loads and functions correctly with proper authentication
Admin can add, edit, delete products through dashboard
Admin can view and update order status
Mobile responsive design works across all pages
Product images display correctly with fallback placeholders
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix session cookie authentication for regular users. Admin authentication works with domain '.preview.emergentagent.com' but regular users cannot authenticate with same configuration. This blocks checkout flow testing. All backend APIs are working perfectly.

success_percentage.frontend: 85% (12/14 major flows working, authentication blocking 2 flows)
